_about: The stock startup.cfg without its fourteen lines that name a console command 0.26g has none of (the owner, 2026-11-21: the console and the logs without lines that tell nothing). game::on_configs_loaded runs it at every start (load_cc_script 0x1EC380, mask 1), and console_commands::execute logged 'unknown command [<name>]' for each (0xEBC37); no exe patch registers any of them before it runs, so none had an effect.
